title: Robert R. Steuer
vital_facts: Born 1943 Milwaukee, Wisconsin; Reared in Salt Lake City
Baptized at age 9; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Margaret Black 1971, Logan Utah Temple; five children
Elder's Quorum President, Bishop, Stake Mission President, Institute of Religion Instructor, High Councilor
President of Brazil Sao Paulo Mission 1984-1987
